dct_description_sm:
Use the Geospatial Ontario Imagery Orders App to select and request uncompressed or compressed digital imagery tiles from Geospatial Ontario for transfer directly to you.

The aerial imagery from which the orthophotography was derived, was collected during the spring of 2002. The imagery features 20 cm resolution for Niagara, Hamilton, Halton, Peel, York, Toronto and Durham, 30 cm resolution for Simcoe, and 50cm resolution for Peterborough and Northumberland.
  • Time of Capture: Spring 2002
  • Coverage: Approximately 26,000 sq km
  • Canopy Coverage: Leaf-Off

Available Products
Orthorectified Tiles - 1km x 2km, 20cm to 50cm resolution, 8-bit, RGB in .TIFF format (approx. 11MB to 72MB/tile) and a compressed format (approx. 0.2MB to 1.45MB/tile)
  • Greater Toronto Area (GTA) 2002 - Ortho Index (Shapefile)

Additional Resources
  • Imagery User Guide (.docx)
Status
Completed: Production of the data has been completed

Maintenance and Update Frequency
Not planned: There are no plans to update the data
